Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct

def bmp(width,height,depth,ncolors,ih=124):
    fdatabpl=4*((width*depth+31)//32)
    off=14+ih+4*ncolors
    size=off+fdatabpl*height
    fh=bytearray(14); fh[:2]=b'BM'; struct.pack_into('<I',fh,2,size); struct.pack_into('<I',fh,10,off)
    ihb=bytearray(ih); struct.pack_into('<I',ihb,0,ih); struct.pack_into('<i',ihb,4,width); struct.pack_into('<i',ihb,8,height); struct.pack_into('<H',ihb,12,1); struct.pack_into('<H',ihb,14,depth); struct.pack_into('<I',ihb,16,0); struct.pack_into('<I',ihb,20,fdatabpl*height)
    cmap=bytearray()
    for i in range(ncolors): cmap += bytes([(i*33)&255,(i*17)&255,(i*9)&255,255])
    return b'\0'*6 + bytes(fh)+bytes(ihb)+bytes(cmap)+bytes([0x55])*(fdatabpl*height)
for depth in [16,24,32]:
  for nc in [2,16,256]:
    fn=f'/workspace/bmp_d{depth}_c{nc}'
    open(fn,'wb').write(bmp(8,8,depth,nc))
    print(fn)
